job_description.title: Head of AI Platform
job_description.requirements: We are seeking a Head of AI Platform to lead our next-generation generative AI infrastructure. This leader will manage a team of platform engineers, data scientists, and MLOps specialists. Must have 10+ years of AI/ML leadership and deep experience in platform scaling, model deployment, and cloud architecture (AWS, GCP). Responsibilities include defining the strategic roadmap for our internal AI platform, collaborating with product teams to drive adoption, and ensuring system reliability and cost-efficiency. Direct experience with scaling is a must. Experience with LLM orchestration and agentic systems is a major plus.
